description: This file defines the CompilerRuntime class which compiles JMESPath expressions into PHP code, executes them, and manages related cache files. It contains methods for constructing the runtime environment, compiling expressions, and invoking compiled functions.

classes.name: CompilerRuntime
classes.description: A class that compiles JMESPath expressions to PHP source code and executes them, utilizing a cache directory for storing generated code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser, compiler, cache directory, and interpreter. Creates cache directory if necessary.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the object to be invoked as a function, evaluating a JMESPath expression against data by compiling it if needed and executing the resulting function.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a JMESPath expression into PHP code, saving it to a specified file.
